Example (reproducible): find free-with-ads movies programmatically (legal sources only)

```python
import requests

# Example: search for public-domain / free-to-watch titles on the Internet Archive
# (Internet Archive hosts many items that are legitimately shareable; always verify rights per item.)
query = "collection:(feature_films) AND mediatype:(movies)"
url = "https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php"

params = {
    "q": query,
    "fl[]": ["identifier", "title", "year"],
    "sort[]": "year desc",
    "rows": 5,
    "page": 1,
    "output": "json",
}

resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=30)
resp.raise_for_status()
data = resp.json()["response"]["docs"]

for item in data:
    identifier = item["identifier"]
    title = item.get("title", "Untitled")
    year = item.get("year", "Unknown year")
    print(f"{title} ({year}) -> https://archive.org/details/{identifier}")
```

- Run it with Python 3 (`pip install requests`).
